source_findings: The selected patch changes exactly the five registered production paths and one registered pure test path. The public harness.v1 revision2 DTO and strict additionalProperties rules are unchanged.

The progress view receives the selected typed Task and its event window. The four stages use only Task status, actual RunRef, and TOOL_EVENT rows matching the selected Task and current run_id plus epoch; event_id deduplication and positive sequence checks avoid stale or duplicate count inflation.

A QUEUED Task without Run explicitly says no Run. UNKNOWN and CANCEL_REQUESTED remain unresolved. COMPLETED says execution ended and still requires independent result review; the revised observed marker uses neutral accent rather than success color.
Tool counts are labeled observed current event window; zero does not claim no historical tool use. No tokens, cost, Git, model thought, plan, or acceptance facts are synthesized.

Permission text maps current Host reason codes including PERMISSION_PROFILE_UNVERIFIED to readable explanations, preserves each raw code in a disclosure, and treats unknown or missing codes as unconfirmed. It does not change canSubmitHarness or any request, draft, pending journal, idempotency, task/run/epoch, or cancel handler.

The first 12920 bytes of workbench.css exactly match the prior approved mobile scroll CSS SHA256 1eb31349a959f826f462febddc13c2ebb2e66b9afb0c18d38b8b1f1605180647; new CSS is appended and scoped to the progress components.
